topic.title: What if Africa split in two along the East African Rift?
topic.map_answer: the East African Rift itself: a line down the map from the Afar through Ethiopia, Kenya and Tanzania; flood it with sea and everything east of the line becomes an island, everything west gets a new coast

shape.name: The crack
shape.beats: hook: the continent and the question -> the crack already there, a figure -> the line it belongs to, drawn down the map -> how fast it opens -> run the clock: the sea breaks in, the crack floods south, the east breaks off, each a redraw of the coast -> the turn: countries with no sea get a coast -> payoff: the crack that opened in days -> loop to the whole continent
shape.why: a what-if where one line on the map is erased and redrawn as coast, step by step, until one continent is two

title: What if Africa split in two?
description:
Africa is already cracking open in Ethiopia. What happens if it never stops?
The East African Rift on the map: the sea breaks in, a new coast is drawn and the Horn of Africa sails off as an island.
Sources: University of Bristol, Wikipedia (Nov 2026). The characters are not advisers.
